env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A call that returns a tuple keeps its whole span when the callee is a
# generic instantiation, a parenthesised name, or a function literal, so
# a tuple variable can hold its result. The module runs natively, ejects,
# and the ejected module builds and runs with go and with go1.27.2 from
# $UPROOT1272 and prints the same output.
cd m
logos run .
stdout '^1 <nil> 3 <nil> 5 <nil> 7 <nil>$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/tuplecallee

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func pair() (int, error) {
	return 3, nil
}

func pair2[T any](v T) (T, error) {
	return v, nil
}

func main() {
	t := pair2[int](1)
	a, b := t
	u := (pair)()
	c, d := u
	v := func() (int, error) { return 5, nil }()
	e, f := v
	w := pair2[int](7) // comment after a generic call
	g, h := w
	fmt.Println(a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h)
}
